name: PMBrain Agent Capability Pack
description: Official host-agent workflow templates for safe PMBrain retrieval, review, correction, and durable writeback.

skills.name: brain-first
skills.description: Consult PMBrain before answering history-sensitive questions.

skills.name: remember
skills.description: Save knowledge the user explicitly asks PMBrain to remember.

skills.name: durable-writeback
skills.description: Persist clearly established long-lived outcomes from the current task.

skills.name: correction
skills.description: Investigate and precisely correct wrong or stale PMBrain knowledge.

skills.name: takes-review
skills.description: Present pending take proposals and apply only explicit user review decisions.

skills.name: brain-ingest-gate
skills.description: Check durability, provenance, entity identity, and duplication before writing.

skills.name: resolve-before-asking
skills.description: Use stored context to resolve ambiguous references before asking the user.

skills.name: data-loss-gate
skills.description: Require scoped impact review and confirmation before destructive knowledge actions.

skills.name: fact-check
skills.description: Classify factual claims using PMBrain evidence and original source context.

skills.name: conversation-summary
skills.description: Extract durable outcomes from the current conversation and merge them into PMBrain.
triggers: 把刚才的讨论总结并记住
